title: Subscription hygiene score
description: Computes a composite health score per subscription measuring operational maturity across multiple dimensions.
example_prompt: "Calculate a hygiene score (0-100) for each subscription based on: (1) tag compliance (20%), (2) resource lock coverage (15%), (3) alert rule coverage (20%), (4) diagnostic settings coverage (15%), (5) policy compliance (15%), (6) Defender for Cloud score (15%). Show score breakdown and improvement recommendations for subscriptions scoring < 70."
